summary: Implemented the Tabs widget in src/textual/widgets/_tabs.py and exported it from textual.widgets. It renders labels above an UnderlineBar that highlights the active tab, and renders only the inactive underline when there are no tabs. Clicks activate the nearest tab. Keyboard control covers left/right with wrap-around, 1-based number keys 1-9, and letter search that cycles through labels starting with that letter. Added a demo at sandbox/tabs.py. Nothing was run, per instructions, so the code is verified by reading only. No tests were added and nothing was committed.
